scope: mask-only independent review; no generated H&E was available or used

decisions.reason: All hard gates pass and mask review shows coherent localized moderate immune enrichment. Candidate 01 provides the best combined preservation of source-relative spacing, clustering, count and mature sampling score.
decisions.tissue_geometry: The 46,385-pixel change forms a connected authorized stroma-to-immune region while preserving adjacent tumor and non-target compartments.
decisions.nucleus_layout: Twenty-nine class-2 nuclei are complete, non-overlapping and contained. Source-relative area-p95, count, NND and Ripley ratios are 0.996, 1.221, 0.946 and 1.063.
decisions.coupling: Added immune nuclei occupy authorized changed tissue and transition; quota, seam, compatibility, distribution and density checks pass with sampling score 0.893.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and support-exterior instances remain unchanged without partial-instance, overlap, border or containment violations.
decisions.limitations: Instance count is 22.1% above source but within the frozen research envelope. Mask-only evidence does not establish generated-H&E quality or clinical validity.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 01 as the single mask-condition handoff.

decisions.reason: Hard gates pass, but candidate 01 has closer source-relative NND, slightly lower count inflation, slightly closer Ripley clustering and a higher sampling score.
